1. Screen Studio 4.0

Tagline: Glass Loupe, Camera Cutout, Edit by Transcript, and more
Description: The screen recorder for Mac that handles the hard parts: zooms, motion, sound, and framing. Every demo and tutorial comes out polished. What’s new in 4.0: - Glass Loupe, a zoom that magnifies one detail - Split screen, also for vertical video - Edit your video like you edit text - Camera cutout: you, without your background - Hide sensitive data and faces automatically - Sharper zooms, ProRes, up to 4x faster exports, and more

3. Riverside Agents

Tagline: A team of AI agents for video: produce, edit, clip, post
Description: Riverside Agents is a team of AI agents built only for video. A Producer preps your session, an Editor turns raw recordings into a finished episode, a Clipper cuts the best moments into social clips, and a Marketer writes captions and schedules posts. You choose how much to automate, and nothing is published until you approve it. Included in every Riverside plan, with a 14-day free trial.

6. agentmash

Tagline: open-source multiplayer AI for teams’ coding agents
Description: Agentmash is an open-source multiplayer AI for teams’ coding agents, a shared context layer that tells every agent which files a teammate’s agent is changing, so the agents talk to each other and work on their own without overwriting anyone’s code. You can switch between tasks running on different models, @mention a teammate, your own agent or a teammate’s agent like in Slack, and keep skills, chats and automations in sync. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or your own open-source models

Tagline: Managed agents API that works with any model
Description: Managed Agents API you can use with any model. Send a task with an API call, and Click runs the agent and streams back results. Click gives you the entire agent stack over an API, with no infrastructure to manage. Sessions are created with everything your agent needs - a sandbox, browser, and web search. Agents run on a harness with the latest innovations, like deferred tool discovery to support 1000s of tools, and Code Mode to use tools with scripts.
